title: Gotta love these tales. #broadway
transcript: So one day, the director spit on me and I said, thank you. On opening night, we had a standing ovation. The crowd was going wild. And then the producer came up on stage and said, he just committed a m*rder. And the audience laughed, and he said, no, really, I k*lled a guy in Schubert Alley. And it got us the front page of the times. And then Lee Roy Reams got wind that the show was closing at intermission. So we just did Act 1 again… and again… One morning, I woke up and discovered my temporary eye blindness was back. And I still went on! …and again… But during previews, we had a live tiger run up and down the aisle and then jump through a hoop on stage. But it never remembered the blocking, so it was cut. That wasn't the only thing that was cut… Oh, we had no air conditioning, and it was the hottest summer on record. We had an ice girl. She put ice down your shorts. And later we discovered it was a young Helen Mirren. …And again… if you felt a little peaked during an 18 hour day, we have what you called the “power powder.” The giant New York City set just toppled over and fell on our star because the stage hands were all back, you know, and she got up, pushed that set back up and finished her number with one leg. Now, that's a star. Now, we didn't Have agents Then. instead, you submitted by slipping a flask to the stage manager and going upstairs to the producer's “office.” Hmm. …And again.
